responsibility: Implements lowering of Rust function and self parameters into backend parameter variables. It interprets identifier, wildcard, and destructuring parameter patterns, applies mutability to the parameter type, creates the formal parameter Bvariables attached to a function decl, and, for structured patterns, seeds later pattern-binding extraction from an anonymous parameter object; it also provides the dedicated lowering of Rust self parameters based on implicit self kind.
same_name_distinction: Implements parameter-pattern lowering by visiting identifier, wildcard, and destructuring patterns, creating backend parameter variables, and seeding pattern bindings; it also materializes self-parameter handling. Unlike the header, this file performs the actual pattern-specific compilation work rather than only declaring the parameter helper classes.
